# COMPRIME TABLA PRINCIPAL (COMPRESS=YES no aplica en SQL Server; se conserva el contenido)
bd_ctsi = pd.read_sql(text("SELECT * FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI"), engine)
_log("bd_ctsi", bd_ctsi)
# CALCULO DE REAJUSTES DE INST AF.29 Y AF.42 DE TODOS LOS SECTORES QUE SE IMPUTAN EN CTA YG COMO INTERESES
# INCORPORA SECTOR DE CONTRAPARTIDA Y SECTOR DETALLADO
# Crea/reemplaza la tabla física TABLAS.REAJUSTES: es la base inicial sobre la que
# luego se hacen los APPEND (FM_SECT_HH, FM_SECT, REAJ_FM_H, D44) y las lecturas
# posteriores (REAJ_FM_H, D44) que esperan encontrar aquí también las filas D.41 originales.
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #reajustes"))
sql_reajustes = """
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,
       t1.AÑO,
       t1.TRIM,
       t1.SECTOR,
       LTRIM(CAST(t3.C_SI AS char(8))) AS C_CAGENTE,
       'YG' AS C_CUENTA,
       CASE WHEN t1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' THEN 'H' ELSE 'D' END AS C_ENTRADA,
       SUM(t1.DATO) AS DATO,
       CAST('D.41' AS varchar(5)) AS C_SCN,
       CAST('Intereses' AS varchar(70)) AS N_SCN,
       'DI_Aj_REAJ' AS FUENTE
INTO #reajustes
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_SECTORIZACION t2 ON t1.SECTOR = t2.C_SI
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS t3 ON t1.C_CAGENTE = t3.C_CAGENTE
WHERE t1.C_SCN IN ('AF.29', 'AF.42')
  AND t1.C_CUENTA = 'Rec Precio Reaj'
  AND t2.C_SI_Publ <> 6
GROUP BY t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR,
         CASE WHEN t1.C_ENTRADA = 'D' THEN 'H' ELSE 'D' END,
         t3.C_SI
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_reajustes))
# Vuelca #reajustes hacia la tabla física TABLAS.REAJUSTES: SAS reemplazaba la tabla completa
# con este CREATE TABLE inicial (antes de los APPEND posteriores)
work_conn.execute(text("DELETE FROM TABLAS.dbo.REAJUSTES"))
cols_reajustes = "MONEDA, AÑO, TRIM, SECTOR, C_CAGENTE, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, DATO, C_SCN, N_SCN, FUENTE"
sql_insert_reajustes = f"""
INSERT INTO TABLAS.dbo.REAJUSTES ({cols_reajustes})
SELECT {cols_reajustes} FROM #reajustes
"""
res = work_conn.execute(text(sql_insert_reajustes))
_log("REPLACE TABLAS.dbo.REAJUSTES (base D.41 Intereses)", res.rowcount)
# CALCULA ESTRUCTURA SIN HOGARES PARA SECTORIZAR REAJUSTES A PAGAR POR FONDOS MUTUOS MONEY MARKET Y NO MONEY MARKET
# BALANCE DEPOSITOS FFMM POR SECTOR SIN HOGARES
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #bce_dep_fm"))
sql_bce_dep_fm = """
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,
       t1.AÑO,
       t1.TRIM,
       t1.SECTOR,
       t1.C_CAGENTE,
       t1.C_CUENTA,
       t1.C_ENTRADA,
       SUM(t1.DATO) AS DATO,
       t1.C_SCN
INTO #bce_dep_fm
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI t1
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_SECTORIZACION t2 ON t1.SECTOR = t2.C_SI
WHERE t1.C_SCN IN ('AF.521', 'AF.522')
  AND t1.C_CUENTA = 'Bce Final'
  AND t1.SECTOR IN (3390102, 3390101)
  AND t1.C_ENTRADA = 'H'
  AND t1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('511')
GROUP BY t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, t1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN, t1.C_CAGENTE
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_bce_dep_fm))
bce_dep_fm = pd.read_sql(text("SELECT * FROM #bce_dep_fm"), work_conn)
_log("bce_dep_fm", bce_dep_fm)
# BALANCE DEPOSITOS FFMM TOTAL SIN HOGARES
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #bce_dep_tot"))
sql_bce_dep_tot = """
SELECT t1.MONEDA,
       t1.AÑO,
       t1.TRIM,
       t1.SECTOR,
       t1.C_CUENTA,
       t1.C_ENTRADA,
       SUM(t1.DATO) AS DATO,
       t1.C_SCN
INTO #bce_dep_tot
FROM #bce_dep_fm t1
GROUP BY t1.MONEDA, t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_ENTRADA, t1.C_SCN
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_bce_dep_tot))
bce_dep_tot = pd.read_sql(text("SELECT * FROM #bce_dep_tot"), work_conn)
_log("bce_dep_tot", bce_dep_tot)
# CALCULA ESTRUCTURA PARA SECTORIZAR REAJUSTES SIN HOGARES
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #est_reaj"))
sql_est_reaj = """
SELECT t1.AÑO,
       t1.TRIM,
       t1.SECTOR,
       LTRIM(CAST(t3.C_SI AS char(8))) AS C_CAGENTE,
       SUM(t1.DATO / t2.DATO) AS EST
INTO #est_reaj
FROM #bce_dep_fm t1
INNER JOIN #bce_dep_tot t2
  ON t1.AÑO = t2.AÑO AND t1.TRIM = t2.TRIM AND t1.SECTOR = t2.SECTOR
INNER JOIN TABLAS.dbo.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS t3 ON t1.C_CAGENTE = t3.C_CAGENTE
GROUP BY t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.SECTOR, t3.C_SI
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_est_reaj))
